importantTopics: Kirchhoff's Laws, Mesh and Nodal Analysis
Measuring Instruments: PMMC, Moving Iron, Dynamometer
likelyQuestions: Explain KCL and KVL with examples; differentiate mesh and nodal analysis.
Draw the equivalent circuit of a single-phase transformer, derive its EMF equation and explain core and copper losses; define voltage regulation.
Using Thevenin's theorem, find the current through the 10 Ω resistor; state and prove maximum power transfer.
Derive the resonant frequency, Q-factor and bandwidth of a series RLC circuit and plot the response.
Describe the construction and working of a moving-iron instrument and compare with moving-coil.
Explain the two-wattmeter method of measuring three-phase power.
Derive the average value of a sinusoidal wave; draw the phasor diagram of series RL and derive its impedance.
Find the current through the 10 Ω resistor in the given circuit using mesh and nodal analysis.
Explain the construction of a DC generator and the working of a DC motor; derive the back-EMF and torque equations.
State and explain superposition and Millman's theorems.
